faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DoT Junior Engineer (Telecom) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DoT Junior Engineer (Telecom) recruitment is 29th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Engineer (Telecom) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree in engineering or technology in relevant fields like Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or Information Technology from a recognized University or Institute. Specific professional qualifications are also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DoT Junior Engineer (Telecom) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Engineer (Telecom) post is 56 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Engineer (Telecom) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Engineer (Telecom) post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400 per month, which corresponds to Level 6 of the pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Engineer (Telecom) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Engineer (Telecom) position by the Department of Telecommunications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DoT Junior Engineer (Telecom) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Engineer (Telecom) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Engineer (Telecom) role will be as decided by the Competent Authority. Further details regarding the specific selection method are expected in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation, indicating that the position is for individuals already in government service who are being deputed to this role.
